objective: Evidence-backed JNU decision architecture with strict data integrity, OOS validation and no post-hoc rescue.

rules: Historical session versions must be date-correct.
Predictors must be available strictly before target decision time.
Contract/trading-day/roll identity must be resolved before signal evaluation.
Licensing/storage boundary is part of data integrity.

layers.rule: Interpret signals conditionally by OSE/Japan cash/lunch/bridge/night/US/post-US session; no universal all-session weight.
Determine which venue/region is informative now; not standalone directional alpha.
layers.blocked_on: Approved venue-specific OSE + SGX intraday data.

admitted_candidates.true_jnu_data_policy: 225Labo raw local-only under personal-use terms; cloud receives non-reconstructive derived panel/results only.

results.guardrail: Do not rescue post hoc by selecting the high-VIX subset.
No fourth acquisition attempt and no significance interpretation.

layers.guardrail: Do not tune FIRST_30M/LAST_30M, switch SPX to NQ, or use proxy results for formal promotion.

layers.evidence: Direct Japanese evidence exists for MPM-release effects on Nikkei 225 VI and VI futures; BOJ also provides official release dates/times.
layers.data_feasibility: Public Nikkei Indexes access provides only 3 years of daily and 10 years of monthly index data, insufficient for a robust replication of the cited intraday event effect. No weak small-event daily substitute will be opened.
layers.generation1_role: Event volatility/risk state only; no directional claim.

layers.rule: Do not infer order imbalance from OHLC/VWAP/volume.
Only validated or explicitly conditional modules may influence probabilities. Rejected or data-inconclusive families cannot re-enter without a new preregistration.

active_research.rule: Do not start a weaker proxy family merely to keep testing while the evidence-matched data are unavailable.

next_gate: Restore authorized local-device access to the personally licensed OSE data or verify another approved true-OSE intraday source; then execute the already-frozen HAR-RSV true-OSE confirmation first, followed by the frozen US-to-JNU intraday-path family if data requirements are met.
